"""Independent retained-formula replay and invocation guard checks; no native/Cargo."""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT=Path('/Users/erik/.codex/worktrees/1598/umf')
SELF=Path('/private/tmp/record-home-correspondence-astra-review.py')
if Path.cwd().resolve()!=ROOT or Path(__file__).resolve()!=SELF or len(sys.argv)!=1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unknown exact independent review invocation')
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
producer='tools/security/prove-record-home-correspondence.py'
proof_path='docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security/record-home-correspondence-formal.json'
output=ROOT/'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security/record-home-correspondence-astra-review.json'
prior=output.read_bytes() if output.exists() else None
proof_bytes=(ROOT/proof_path).read_bytes()
proof=json.loads(proof_bytes)
expected_sources={producer,'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/SPIKE-010-security-result-coverage.md',
    'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/record-homes-v0.1.schema.json',
    '/Users/erik/Projects/weft/crates/weft-core/src/security_requirements.rs'}
assert set(proof['sourceDigests'])==expected_sources
captured={p:(ROOT/p).read_bytes() for p in expected_sources}
assert all(sha(raw)==proof['sourceDigests'][p] for p,raw in captured.items())
assert proof['status']=='conditional-proof-passed' and proof['sourcesUnchanged'] is True
assert proof['nativeImplementationQualified'] is False and proof['acceptanceCasesPromoted']==[]
self_bytes=SELF.read_bytes()
spec=importlib.util.find_spec('z3')
assert spec and spec.origin
solver_root=Path(spec.origin).resolve().parent
def runtime_inventory():
    return {Path(sys.executable).resolve()}|{p for p in solver_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix!='.pyc'}
runtime={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in runtime_inventory()}
import z3
assert z3.get_version_string()==proof['solverVersion']

ids=['endpoint-domain-retains-refinements','qualified-reference-injective',
    'unbounded-ordered-key-correspondence','endpoint-role-target-selected-key-ordered-members',
    'same-type-source-reuse-versus-distinct-type-partition',
    'bidirectional-carrier-population-rejects-extra-key','carrier-multiplicity-rejects-duplicate-key',
    'key-population-alone-does-not-prove-field-coherence','utf8-byte-limit-is-not-character-limit',
    'known-native-images-cannot-prune-dead-branch']
assert len(proof['cases'])==10 and [c['id'] for c in proof['cases']]==ids
replays=[]
for case in proof['cases']:
    assert case['covers']==['US-056-AC6','US-056-AC7']
    for kind,expected in [('violation','unsat'),('negativeControl','sat'),('positivePopulation','sat')]:
        retained=case[kind]
        assert retained['result']==retained['replayResult']==expected
        formula=retained['smt']
        assert isinstance(formula,str) and formula
        assert not any(x in formula for x in ['model-add','model-del','model-converter'])
        context=z3.Context();solver=z3.Solver(ctx=context);solver.set(timeout=10000)
        solver.from_string(formula)
        observed=str(solver.check())
        assert observed==expected,(case['id'],kind,observed)
        replays.append({'id':case['id']+'/'+kind,'expected':expected,'observed':observed,
            'formulaSha256':sha(formula.encode()),'freshContext':True})
        del solver,context

# These executions are restricted by the original producer's own invocation guard;
# neither reaches formula construction or receipt publication.
guards=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='record-home-invocation-review-',dir='/private/tmp') as name:
    temporary=Path(name)
    copy=temporary/'producer-copy.py';copy.write_bytes(captured[producer])
    assert sha(copy.read_bytes())==sha(captured[producer])
    for label,command,cwd in [
        ('copied-producer-from-intended-root',[sys.executable,str(copy)],ROOT),
        ('original-producer-from-foreign-root',[sys.executable,str(ROOT/producer)],temporary)]:
        execution=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
        observed=execution.returncode!=0 and execution.stdout=='' and execution.stderr.rstrip().endswith('RuntimeError: Unknown exact proof invocation')
        assert observed,(label,execution.returncode,execution.stdout,execution.stderr)
        assert (ROOT/proof_path).read_bytes()==proof_bytes
        assert not (temporary/proof_path).exists()
        guards.append({'id':label,'expected':True,'observed':observed,'command':command,'cwd':str(cwd),
            'exitCode':execution.returncode,'stdout':execution.stdout,'stderr':execution.stderr,
            'executedSourceSha256':sha(captured[producer]),'receiptUnchanged':True})

assert {str(p) for p in runtime_inventory()}==set(runtime)
assert all(Path(p).read_bytes()==raw for p,raw in runtime.items())
assert all((ROOT/p).read_bytes()==raw for p,raw in captured.items())
assert (ROOT/proof_path).read_bytes()==proof_bytes and SELF.read_bytes()==self_bytes
assert (output.read_bytes() if output.exists() else None)==prior
pins={**{p:sha(raw) for p,raw in captured.items()},proof_path:sha(proof_bytes),str(SELF):sha(self_bytes),
    **{p:sha(raw) for p,raw in runtime.items()}}
receipt={
    'id':'record-home-correspondence-astra-review','reviewer':'/root/astra_security_review',
    'requestedModel':'Astra ultra','status':'qualified-correspondence-review-passed',
    'generatedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'sourceDigests':pins,'sourcesUnchanged':True,
    'reviewCommand':{'argv':[sys.executable,str(SELF)],'cwd':str(ROOT),'sourceSha256':sha(self_bytes),
        'source':self_bytes.decode(),'pythonVersion':sys.version,'solverVersion':z3.get_version_string()},
    'proofSourceDigests':proof['sourceDigests'],'formulaReplays':replays,'invocationControls':guards,
    'observations':{'laws':10,'independentFreshContextReplays':30,'unsat':10,'sat':20,
        'invocationRefusals':2,'successfulProducerExecutions':0,'cargoExecutions':0,'nativeAcquisitions':0,
        'formulaResults':{'expected':{'unsat':10,'sat':20},'observed':{'unsat':10,'sat':20}},
        'invocationGuard':{'expected':2,'observed':len(guards)}},
    'reviewedMeaning':[
        'Qualified references and the five-member normalized-domain datatype retain all modeled components; concrete canonical domain normalization is a premise, not derived.',
        'Ordered component equality is universally quantified over positive arity. The swapped two-component set-equality mutant is satisfiable.',
        'Endpoint correspondence conjoins role, full target, selected Key and ordered members. Its weakened control drops metadata correspondence, not actual source extraction.',
        'The same-type reuse versus distinct-type discriminator partition predicate models this conservative PostgreSQL profile. It does not model native collation or universal UMF disjointness.',
        'Carrier counts are nonnegative, authoritative selected Keys are unique, and bidirectional exact counts reject both extra and duplicate carriers. Both weakened controls retain forward inclusion and a nonempty authoritative population.',
        'The value-coherence control retains exact nonempty Key population but permits a required field mismatch when coherence is omitted.',
        'The identifier law uses an abstract UTF8 size range and explicit 16-scalar/64-byte witness; it does not verify a Unicode encoder.',
        'The known-image law retains a known dead-branch literal in all three formulas; live-branch-only checking admits its unsupported image.'
    ],
    'resolvedFindings':['Original producer now refuses copied-file and foreign-working-directory invocations before receipt publication.'],
    'remainingFindings':[],
    'scope':'Independent source/design review, thirty retained SMT formulas freshly parsed and solved in separate contexts, and two actual rejected producer invocations. The violation formulas are conditional consequences of explicit datatype/equality/count/coherence/image predicates, often definition sanity checks. SAT controls establish nonvacuity or necessity within these abstractions, not extraction or implementation refinement. Full Reference and Domain datatypes, native canonical images, complete authoritative population and required-field/literal predicates are supplied modeled meanings. No schema-to-Rust interpreter, actual codec/collation/value extraction, native population/authentication/current authority, backend enforcement or release is established. The successful proof producer run is parent evidence; this review did not regenerate formulas. Independent solver runtime is captured separately; its pins do not retroactively establish producer runtime custody. Platform and process environment remain trusted premises.',
    'nativeImplementationQualified':False,'ownerBindingInterpreterQualifiedByThisProbe':False,'acceptanceCasesPromoted':[]
}
if prior is not None:
    digest=sha(prior);archive=output.with_name('record-home-correspondence-astra-review-prior-'+digest[:16]+'.json')
    if archive.exists() and archive.read_bytes()!=prior:raise RuntimeError('Historical archive collision')
    if not archive.exists():archive.write_bytes(prior)
    receipt['previousReceipt']={'path':str(archive),'sha256':digest,'scope':'Historical only.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'formulas':len(replays),'invocationRefusals':len(guards),
    'sourcePins':len(pins),'output':str(output),'sha256':sha(output.read_bytes())}))
